about: Face Dance as Josie does it: a tight, locked close-up where the face keeps a short pop beat with its brows, cheeks, eyes and mouth. The motion is a face-dance video's: DWPose's body and face landmarks at a person's own proportions, the expression a little exaggerated (1.4 times, the head's own motion untouched) and fitted once onto the drawn face; the take is three chained takes, each starting on the one before's frame 96. {Lead} is that role's name and look.

sound.note: The trend's own sound is a licensed song and is not shipped: our version's preview plays silent. A version made from this recipe follows a track Mixer makes in the trend's feel. A recipe that names a sound ("mix" for the cut, "vocals" for the mouths) uses it instead.

roles.look: a young woman with warm brown skin and freckles, caramel-blonde curls in a messy bun with loose curls at her face, small gold hoop earrings and a butter-yellow hoodie

beats.text: Her face keeps the beat: a brow, the cheeks, the eyes, the mouth, and a wide-eyed puff at the end

shots.prompt: Tight vertical close-up of {Lead}'s face and shoulders against a plain soft lilac-grey wall in soft even light, the camera locked. {Lead} stays silent and does a rhythmic face dance in time with a short pop beat: one brow lifts on an accent, then the cheeks puff, the eyes widen, the mouth rounds and the brows reset, each on its own beat, the head tilting a little with the rhythm, all of it with exact, playful, exaggerated expressions. Polished 3D animated feature-film style, a soft shallow depth of field.
